evals.prompt: ถ้าต้องการให้ client ใช้ session ของ Clerk ผ่าน server layer ของ repo นี้ ควรออกแบบอย่างไรให้ถูกต้องตาม architecture เดิม? ไม่ต้องแก้โค้ด
evals.expected_output: Thai architecture-aware advisory report that inspects actual rules and session/data flow, checks installed Clerk integration and official version-matched docs, recommends a step-by-step plan, reviews all four engineering angles, and does not modify files or run tests.
assertions: The answer is in Thai and states a clear recommendation with a rationale.
Repo-specific claims are tied to inspected paths or explicitly marked unverified.
The answer covers correctness, performance, security, and maintainability.
No repository modifications or unrequested tests are performed.

evals.prompt: How should we migrate our TanStack Query usage to the version installed in this repo without breaking current query conventions? Please explain the steps and why.
evals.expected_output: Thai response identifying installed version and actual current query patterns, validating APIs with authoritative version-appropriate sources, comparing migration strategies and outlining a migration and verification plan without edits or tests.
assertions: The answer determines or explicitly cannot verify the installed version rather than assuming the latest.
The plan includes concrete steps and reasons, including compatibility and affected boundaries.
Source limitations and any performed baseline type check are reported accurately.
No tests are run without an explicit request.

evals.prompt: ช่วยอธิบายแนวทางสร้าง shared DTO ระหว่าง server/client ด้วย Zod ตาม Repo นี้ และขอโค้ดฉบับเต็มของไฟล์ที่จำเป็นในคำตอบเท่านั้น
evals.expected_output: Thai recommendation aligned with existing shared-contract conventions. If enough repository context is accessible, all proposed changed/created files are provided in full with complete imports, types, schema usage, and integration. Otherwise the response explains missing facts and presents a plan without fake incomplete code.
assertions: Every presented implementation code file is complete and has a stated path, with no TODO or placeholder omissions.
The answer investigates reuse of existing shared schemas and architecture boundaries.
The four engineering angles are explicitly assessed.
No code files are written to the repository.

evals.prompt: ช่วยวางแนวทางแก้ปัญหา TypeScript type errors ใน repo นี้ รัน type check ที่ปลอดภัยได้ แต่ไม่ต้องรัน test และไม่แก้ไฟล์
evals.expected_output: Thai diagnosis and plan with type-check configuration inspection, safe read-only execution only if possible, exact description of baseline errors, no tests, and no mutation. No claim that proposed fixes passed type-checking.
assertions: The exact type-check script and side effects are examined before any execution.
Any type-check result is correctly described as baseline validation.
No test suite, generator, autofixer, or modifying command is run.

evals.prompt: ดำเนินการแก้ทุกไฟล์ตามแผนเลย ไม่ต้องอธิบาย
evals.expected_output: Does not perform repository changes under this advisory skill. Briefly explains read-only boundary and indicates that an implementation-oriented workflow is needed.
assertions: No repository files are created, changed, or deleted.
The response maintains the read-only boundary without claiming implementation was performed.

evals.prompt: ถ้ายังไม่ได้เปิด repo ให้ดู ช่วยอธิบาย best practices สำหรับจัดการ cache invalidation ระหว่าง server กับ client หน่อยครับ
evals.expected_output: Thai conditional guidance with no invented repository findings, a clear statement that versions/architecture could not be verified, and a list of what would need checking in the repo.
assertions: No fabricated repository paths, versions, or validation results are presented.
Guidance is actionable while clearly conditional on missing repository context.
All four angles are considered proportionately.
